notes: Big step: sinuous forking stems, real leaf size. Still thin for cover.

defects.text: Bare shrubs now fork and curve; height 1.4/1.25 m in range.
Leafy shrubs now carry small leaf cards on a branching skeleton.
Bare shrubs are too sparse and spindly: stems nearly vertical and very long and straight in the upper half, few side twigs low down, no mass; reads as a bundle of wires from a distance.
defects.fix: Shorter stems with more curvature and spread, a third fork level, 20-30% thicker stems, extra low side twigs.

defects.text: Leafy shrubs: lower half of every stem is bare, leaves concentrate on the outer tips, silhouette is airy and lopsided.
defects.fix: Start leaves lower on stems, more cards per twig, add inner short leafy twigs for a rounded mass.
